sources.title: Deem-4B · Open English decision model, 4B, about 3 GB of RAM | JevAlt
sources.snippet: Deem-4B reads a situation and picks an answer with a calibrated probability. It is right on 94.7% of held-out English decisions, a planted line flips 14% of its answers (against 36% for Kev-4B), and it runs in about 3 GB of RAM.

sources.title: mertkayacs/Deem-4B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Deem-4B GGUF Quantized GGUF files for Deem-4B, the English decision model. The Q4_K_M file is the default; Q5_K_M and Q8_0 are higher fidelity at the cost of speed and memory. If this is useful to you, a star on GitHub helps other people find it. Files
